title: How to Fine-Tune Open Source LLMs with Nebius Token Factory | Full Tutorial

blurb: Hands-on tutorial fine-tuning the GPT-OSS 20B model on Nebius Token Factory: environment setup, JSONL dataset upload, creating a fine-tuning job, monitoring training, and downloading artifacts.

title: Exploring Nebius Token Factory | Open LLMs, AI Agents, Batch Inference & Fine-Tuning

title: Deploying a Knowledge-Based Chatbot with RAG in Production

title: Agentic Search with Tavily — AI Build & Learn
